Source snapshot: DMs Revenue Flow public investor page, https://dmrevenueflow.com/
Snapshot date: 2026-05-21

The public investor page says DMs Revenue Flow is raising $3M pre-seed for 15% equity.

The public investor page says the raise implies a $17M pre-money valuation and a $20M post-money valuation.

The public investor page says the planned runway is 24 months.

The use-of-funds section says 35% of proceeds are planned for team and payroll, 30% for marketing and CAC, 15% for AI infrastructure, 10% for operations, and 10% for working capital.

The same public page says a $200k strategic investor commitment validates the thesis and de-risks the round for co-investors, with details available under NDA.
